title: Strip R-CNN: Large Strip Convolution for Remote Sensing Object Detection
mechanism: Sequential orthogonal large strip convolutions aggregate context along the dominant axis of slender objects, avoiding the dilution of large square kernels.
adaptation: Add a large-strip context block (k 31 to 63) on 1/4 and 1/8 features of the house encoder; targets long axis-aligned classes (gridline, ribbons, splice, busbars) and long cracks across the cell.
min_experiment: Arm: house + strip context block, 5 seeds. Metrics: gridline IoU, splice IoU, mIoU_rob. Kill: gridline IoU gain < 0.03 and mIoU_rob gain < 0.005.
evidence: DOTA-v1.0 82.75 mAP with 30M params, gains on FAIR1M, HRSC2016, DIOR (detection, not segmentation).
